Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need an appointment?

No appointment is needed. Just come by the shop Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with the item or the piece you want looked at, and we’ll review it with you in person.

Can you give me a price over the phone?

We can give you a ballpark range for most work over the phone, but an exact price takes an in-person look — the frame, foam, and size of the piece all change the price, and we’d rather be honest than guess.

Do you do estimates at my home or business?

We don’t do in-home estimates. Bring the item to the shop during open hours and we’ll look at everything together — photos and measurements are welcome too, they just don’t replace seeing it in person.

How long does upholstery work take?

Smaller jobs often start within a few days and take a few days to about a week. Bigger projects — boats, full car interiors, restaurant work — usually start about a week out and take a solid week or two, sometimes more. The shop can talk through timing for your piece in person.
